extracted.name: Strawberry Shortcake Drink
extracted.description: This yummy pink ice cream-based cocktail blends the flavors of amaretto liqueur, vanilla ice cream, and strawberries.
instruction_lines: Place thawed frozen strawberries, amaretto liqueur, vanilla ice cream, vanilla extract, crushed ice, and vanilla vodka into a blender.
Pour into a glass and garnish with whipped cream and a fresh strawberry.
